decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1.1 (received 20/05/2013), 01 Rev A (received 16/07/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Other than as specified in the application, no additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  north east and south west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The window formed in the south western elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a part single storey and part two storey rear extension to the house
